causal.assumptions_right: Concentrated unhedged receive while March 2027 was rich to cash; implied-rate compression, not FX or oil, was the driver; exiting at 3.00 locked the move before dual central-bank week.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Once the mark reached 3.00, leftover versus cash was event binary on the 28 October 2.50 decision rather than residual swing edge.
causal.causal_divergence: The 13bp compression was the original mispricing being extracted. After 3.00 the remaining gap versus cash was meeting-week binary, which is why the book was closed rather than held.
causal.future_implication: Do not reopen the same CORRA receive within a few basis points of a just-booked exit unless a new dislocation appears versus cash or versus the announced Bank of Canada path.
causal.observed_reality: The mark fell 13bp from 3.13 to 3.00 as the priced Canadian hike path compressed; leftover versus cash then became event risk rather than extractable mispricing.
causal.original_belief: Receive March 2027 CORRA while the contract was rich to cash; implied would compress toward cash 2.25 and a near-term 2.50 Bank of Canada outcome.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: Holding through Bank of Canada and the Fed would have converted a harvested 13bp swing into a binary on the 28 October 2.50 decision. A hawkish March 2027 repricing back through 3.13 before the close would have erased the trade.

items.expression_assessment: Outright March 2027 CORRA receive isolated implied-rate compression rather than FX or oil.

facts.invalidation: Close if BoC delivers or explicitly endorses a 2027 path consistent with CRAH27 holding at or above the 3.13 entry, or if Canada CPI-trim/median leave the packet 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment/wages reverse the August -42k / +2.0% cooling. Close if CRAH27 implied rises toward CRAM27 3.365 rather than cheapening. A US-only SOFR selloff that leaves CORRA_2027-03 unchanged is not invalidation. Energy headlines without a core/labor break are not invalidation. No hedge: if the thesis fails, close.

items.future_rule: Do not reopen the same CORRA receive within a few basis points of a just-booked exit unless a new dislocation appears versus cash or versus the announced Bank of Canada path.
items.lesson: A realized receive that has already compressed to the event-implied print is finished; the next 10bp is meeting-week binary, not the original mispricing.
items.sizing_assessment: Size came from the adverse path, not notional hunger, and the close did not leave a warehouse stub.
items.thesis_assessment: Rich-to-cash receive was the right concentrated expression while 3.13 still sat well above cash and the near-term 2.50 path.
items.timing_assessment: The 3.00 exit locked the 13bp before dual central-bank week converted leftover versus cash into event binary.
items.what_failed: Nothing material. Tape now 3.005 versus 3.00 exit; almost no residual edge was left on the table.
items.what_worked: Concentrated unhedged receive while March 2027 CORRA was rich to cash; sized from adverse P&L path rather than notional hunger; exited at 3.00 instead of warehousing a finished gap into event week.
